name: print-social-royal-blue-and-black-b2b-marketing-post-mosaic
title: Mosaic of royal-blue, black and white B2B posts with chat bubbles, charts and sticky notes
whatItIs: A cropped grid of portrait posts for a marketing firm: upcoming events cards, a phone with blue and grey chat bubbles, glowing bar chart, a search-bar prompt, a laptop reveal, checklist quiz, a 73% ring stat, a chip list and lime sticky notes on black.
whatItMeans: Confident and tidy; blue glow on black feels techy and clear.
techniques: Vary formats (chat, chart, list, stat) in one blue system.
Use lime sticky notes as the one off-palette accent.
Keep the brand name at the bottom.

vocabulary.definition: A post showing a message conversation.
A ring chart with a large percentage.
A luminous blue blend on black.
